items.reason_zh: Windows Kernel 中存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致本地权限提升；该漏洞属于底层内核缺陷，常被组合利用以实施高级后渗透攻击。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in LSASS allows unauthenticated network attackers to execute arbitrary code, directly compromising Windows credential authentication and enabling full system takeover.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中存在越界写入漏洞，允许未认证的网络攻击者执行任意代码，直接破坏 Windows 凭证认证机制并实现系统全面接管。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in PPP EAP-TLS enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, posing a severe threat to enterprise VPN and remote access deployments.
items.reason_zh: PPP EAP-TLS 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可实现未认证的远程网络 RCE，对企业 VPN 与远程访问部署构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows GDI permits unauthenticated network attackers to execute code remotely, leveraging a widely used graphics subsystem for widespread exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows GDI 中存在越界写入漏洞，允许未认证的网络攻击者远程执行代码；该漏洞利用广泛使用的图形子系统，极易引发大规模利用。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the CD-ROM driver allows unauthenticated network attackers to execute code remotely, bypassing physical media requirements through malicious mount requests.
items.reason_zh: CD-ROM 驱动程序中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者远程执行代码，通过恶意挂载请求绕过物理介质要求。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Shell allows remote code execution. Its high CVSS score and network-accessible vector make it a critical threat for end-user systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。其高 CVSS 评分和网络访问向量使其对终端用户系统构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Windows PowerShell enables remote code execution. Attackers can leverage this for automated command execution without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Windows PowerShell 中的整数下溢漏洞可导致远程代码执行。攻击者可利用此漏洞在无需用户交互的情况下自动执行命令。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Windows Encrypting File System (EFS) permits remote code execution. This directly compromises encrypted data protection and system integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows 加密文件系统 (EFS) 中的代码注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行。该漏洞直接破坏了加密数据保护机制和系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Remote Desktop Client facilitates remote code execution. It poses a severe risk to administrators accessing remote machines.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行。这对访问远程计算机的管理员构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Windows Credential Guard allows local credential spoofing. This undermines enterprise identity management and lateral movement defenses.
items.reason_zh: Windows Credential Guard 中缺失的身份验证机制允许本地凭据伪造。这削弱了企业身份管理防御及横向移动防护能力。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Rich Text Edit allows unauthenticated network RCE. Critical due to widespread client usage and remote exploitation potential.
items.reason_zh: Rich Text Edit 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行 (RCE)。鉴于客户端广泛使用及远程利用潜力，该漏洞危害极大。

items.reason_en: Use after free in LSASS allows local privilege escalation. Directly targets Windows credential protection, enabling full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的释放后使用 (Use-After-Free) 漏洞可导致本地权限提升。该漏洞直接针对 Windows 凭据保护机制，可实现完全的系统入侵。

items.reason_en: Use after free in TCP/IP allows unauthenticated network RCE. Exploiting the core networking stack grants immediate remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行。利用核心网络组件即可立即实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in SMB Server allows unauthenticated DoS. Severely impacts critical file-sharing and inter-server communication availability.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server 中的资源耗尽漏洞可导致未经身份验证的拒绝服务 (DoS) 攻击。严重影响关键文件共享及服务器间通信服务的可用性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in DHCP Server allows unauthenticated network RCE. Compromises essential network address management and infrastructure services.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的越界写入漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行。该漏洞破坏了关键的网路地址管理及基础设施服务。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word enables network-based remote code execution. Its high prevalence in enterprise environments makes it a prime target for phishing-driven attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞支持基于网络的远程代码执行。因其在企业环境中广泛部署，成为网络钓鱼驱动攻击的主要目标。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows Codecs Library allows unauthorized network RCE via malicious image files. As a deeply integrated system component, it presents a broad attack surface across supported Windows releases.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library 中的整数溢出漏洞可通过恶意图像文件实现未经授权的网络远程代码执行。作为深度集成的系统组件，它在所有受支持的 Windows 版本中均呈现广泛的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Windows Distributed File System permits network privilege escalation. This flaw directly impacts distributed storage infrastructure commonly deployed in corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Distributed File System 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致网络权限提升。该缺陷直接影响企业网络中常见的分布式存储基础设施。

items.reason_en: Allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code as LocalSystem on Windows, posing a critical system compromise risk that bypasses standard privilege boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者在 Windows 上以 LocalSystem 身份执行任意代码，存在绕过标准权限边界、导致系统被严重入侵的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in Scribus allows memory corruption via crafted PICT files, potentially leading to application crashes or arbitrary code execution during image import.
items.reason_zh: Scribus 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过构造的 PICT 文件导致内存损坏，在导入图像时可能引发应用程序崩溃或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Type confusion vulnerability in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution, posing a direct threat to end-user systems browsing malicious content.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的类型混淆漏洞可导致远程代码执行，对浏览恶意内容的终端用户系统构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the .NET runtime allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code, bypassing standard security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: .NET runtime 中的越界写入漏洞允许本地攻击者执行任意代码，从而绕过标准安全边界。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows kernel display driver facilitates local privilege escalation by exploiting graphics subsystem memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: Windows 内核显示驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过利用图形子系统内存损坏实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the NTFS file system driver can leak sensitive memory data and lead to local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 文件系统驱动程序中的越界读取漏洞可能导致敏感内存数据泄露，并引发本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Authorization flaws in .NET Framework allow network-based attackers to escalate privileges, undermining application sandboxing and security models.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的授权缺陷允许基于网络的攻击者提升权限，破坏应用程序沙箱隔离及安全模型。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in GDI+ enables remote code execution over a network, posing a critical threat to Windows endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: GDI+ 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞支持通过网络进行远程代码执行，对 Windows 终端安全构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the SMB Server allows remote code execution, directly compromising file-sharing infrastructure across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接破坏企业网络中的文件共享基础设施。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the WinSock driver is actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), making immediate patching essential for network defense.
items.reason_zh: WinSock 驱动程序中的释放后使用漏洞已在野外被积极利用（见 CISA KEV），因此及时修补对于网络防御至关重要。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in RPC Runtime facilitates remote code execution, undermining inter-process communication and overall system stability.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏进程间通信机制及整体系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Critical 9.8 severity vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution via Windows Deployment Services, posing severe risk to enterprise infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 9.8 的关键漏洞，允许通过 Windows Deployment Services 进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行，对企业基础设施构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network through a stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS, directly compromising network resolution services.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞通过 Windows DNS 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞实现网络上的未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接破坏网络解析服务。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in the Local Security Authority Server allows authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, threatening domain authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行代码，威胁域身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild according to CISA KEV, this code injection flaw in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables authenticated network code execution.
items.reason_zh: 根据 CISA KEV 记录，该 Microsoft Office SharePoint 代码注入漏洞已在野外被积极利用，允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行代码。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution, posing a direct threat to end-users navigating malicious web content.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，对浏览恶意网页内容的终端用户构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification flaw in Microsoft Teams allows privilege escalation and message spoofing, undermining enterprise communication trust.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams中的加密签名验证缺陷可导致权限提升和消息伪造，破坏企业通信信任。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Visual Studio Code permits local attackers to circumvent built-in security features, risking compromised development workstations.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的授权绕过漏洞允许本地攻击者规避内置安全功能，可能导致开发工作站被入侵。

items.reason_en: Blender's heap out-of-bounds access skips size validation in struct layouts, allowing crafted .blend files to trigger memory corruption and potential code execution.
items.reason_zh: Blender的堆越界访问跳过了结构体布局的大小验证，允许构造的.blend文件触发内存损坏及潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: Scribus' PSD loader uses unchecked file values as lookup array indexes, enabling heap corruption that can crash the application or lead to arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: Scribus的PSD加载器使用未检查的文件值作为查找数组索引，可引发堆损坏，导致应用程序崩溃或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: ESET encryption flaws permit standard users to access privileged kernel driver interfaces, bypassing intended access controls and risking system compromise.
items.reason_zh: ESET加密缺陷允许普通用户访问特权内核驱动接口，绕过预期访问控制，危及系统安全。

items.reason_en: Flatpak's XDG Portal FileChooser method lacks proper restriction enforcement, allowing sandboxed apps to gain unintended access to host filesystem paths.
items.reason_zh: Flatpak的XDG Portal FileChooser方法缺乏适当的限制执行机制，使沙箱应用能够意外访问主机文件系统路径。

items.reason_en: Validates user-supplied pitch dimensions to prevent out-of-bounds reads during cursor operations, securing virtualized desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: 对用户提供的pitch（行距）尺寸进行验证，防止光标操作期间发生越界读取，从而保障虚拟化桌面环境安全。

items.reason_en: Fixes a dangling pointer in the AMD display CRTC reset function, preventing kernel crashes during display state transitions.
items.reason_zh: 修复AMD显示CRTC重置函数中的悬垂指针问题，防止显示状态切换期间发生内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Adding TLB flush after MES queue eviction prevents GPU memory isolation breaches and cross-process data leaks.
items.reason_zh: 在MES队列驱逐后添加TLB刷新操作，可防止GPU内存隔离被突破及跨进程数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Fixing credential use-after-free in AppArmor hooks restores mandatory access control integrity for VFS operations.
items.reason_zh: 修复AppArmor钩子中的凭证use-after-free（释放后使用）漏洞，恢复VFS操作的强制访问控制完整性。

items.reason_en: Rejecting oversized instruction buffers in AMDGPU stops GPU command parser exploitation and display driver crashes.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝处理AMDGPU中过大的指令缓冲区，可阻止GPU命令解析器被利用及显示驱动崩溃。

items.reason_en: Initializing mutexes before requesting threaded IRQs eliminates race conditions that crash ALSA audio drivers.
items.reason_zh: 在申请线程化IRQ前初始化互斥锁，消除导致ALSA音频驱动崩溃的竞争条件。

items.reason_en: Rejecting exited perf events as group leaders prevents performance monitoring isolation violations and scheduler abuse.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝将已退出的perf事件作为组头，可防止性能监控隔离违规及调度器滥用。

items.reason_en: The AMDGPU VCN4 driver avoids re-reading IB parameter lengths, fixing a potential TOCTOU condition that could cause GPU command submission failures or crashes during video encoding/decoding workloads.
items.reason_zh: AMDGPU VCN4驱动避免重新读取IB参数长度，修复了潜在的TOCTOU条件竞争，该问题可能在视频编解码负载下导致GPU命令提交失败或崩溃。

items.reason_en: The Radeon DRM driver corrects an integer overflow in the pitch alignment calculation, preventing potential memory corruption and display artifacts during graphics buffer allocation.
items.reason_zh: Radeon DRM驱动修正了pitch对齐计算中的整数溢出问题，防止图形缓冲区分配期间发生潜在的内存损坏和显示异常。

items.reason_en: Non-atomic counter updates in GCOV instrumentation cause concurrent access crashes, posing a high risk for local denial-of-service or privilege escalation during kernel profiling.
items.reason_zh: GCOV插桩中的非原子计数器更新会导致并发访问崩溃，在内核分析期间极易引发本地拒绝服务或权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Slab-out-of-bounds in the mlx5 driver allows local attackers to corrupt kernel memory by exploiting malformed VF vport capability queries.
items.reason_zh: mlx5驱动中的Slab越界访问漏洞允许本地攻击者通过利用格式错误的VF vport能力查询来破坏内核内存。

items.reason_en: A double-free vulnerability in the qla2xxx SCSI driver can trigger kernel panics or arbitrary code execution when error handling paths are invoked.
items.reason_zh: qla2xxx SCSI驱动中的双重释放漏洞在调用错误处理路径时可能触发内核恐慌或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: A bogus memset operation in the HID core enables out-of-bounds writes via malicious USB/HID devices, bypassing standard input device sanitization.
items.reason_zh: HID核心中的虚假memset操作可通过恶意USB/HID设备实现越界写入，绕过了标准输入设备的清理机制。

items.reason_en: Race conditions in routing table deletion functions cause kernel crashes under concurrent network device state changes, severely impacting system stability.
items.reason_zh: 路由表删除函数中的竞争条件在网络设备状态并发变更时会引发内核崩溃，严重影响系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Stale IOTLB entries in IOMMU Shared Virtual Addressing contexts allow DMA-based attacks to access unauthorized kernel memory, compromising system isolation.
items.reason_zh: IOMMU共享虚拟寻址上下文中的陈旧IOTLB条目允许基于DMA的攻击访问未授权的内核内存，破坏系统隔离性。

items.reason_en: Unfreed commands following a chip reset in the qla2xxx driver cause resource exhaustion and potential kernel instability, affecting storage subsystem reliability.
items.reason_zh: qla2xxx驱动中芯片复位后未释放的命令会导致资源耗尽及潜在的内核不稳定，影响存储子系统可靠性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in GPU command submission allows local privilege escalation on ARM-based desktop devices.
items.reason_zh: GPU命令提交过程中的整数溢出漏洞可在基于ARM的桌面设备上实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds array access in the AMD display driver can trigger kernel panics or information leaks during graphical operations.
items.reason_zh: AMD显示驱动中的数组越界访问可能在图形操作期间触发内核恐慌或信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Zero-length socket message handling triggers kernel panics via BPF sockmap, destabilizing desktop networking stacks.
items.reason_zh: 零长度套接字消息处理会通过BPF sockmap触发内核恐慌，破坏桌面网络栈的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption during network interface teardown affects driver stability and can lead to local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 网络接口拆除期间的内存损坏会影响驱动稳定性，并可能导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Vim's netrw plugin allows arbitrary code execution via crafted filenames containing quote characters, posing a direct threat to developers and system administrators who rely on the editor.
items.reason_zh: Vim的netrw插件允许通过包含引号字符的构造文件名执行任意代码，对依赖该编辑器的开发人员和系统管理员构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: An off-by-one error in GLib's key file parsing can trigger out-of-bounds access, destabilizing core GNOME desktop components and dependent applications.
items.reason_zh: GLib键文件解析中的一位错误(off-by-one)可能触发越界访问，破坏GNOME核心桌面组件及依赖应用的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows Mobile Broadband allows information disclosure over a network. Relevant for mobile broadband adapters and cellular connectivity modules.
items.reason_zh: Windows移动宽带组件中的越界读取漏洞允许通过网络泄露信息。主要影响移动宽带适配器和蜂窝连接模块。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge for iOS permits unauthorized network RCE, directly endangering mobile browsing sessions and user data.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge for iOS中的释放后使用(use-after-free)漏洞允许未经授权的远程网络代码执行(RCE)，直接危及移动浏览会话和用户数据。

items.reason_en: Exposes user credentials by triggering HTTP Basic Authentication challenges from unvalidated WebView sources, enabling passive passcode theft in mobile applications.
items.reason_zh: 利用未经验证的 WebView 来源触发 HTTP Basic Authentication 挑战以暴露用户凭据，导致移动应用面临被动窃取密码的风险。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting flaw in Microsoft Teams for Android enables mobile client spoofing attacks, compromising enterprise communication security.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 存在跨站脚本漏洞，可被用于实施移动客户端伪造攻击，危及企业通信安全。

items.reason_en: OS command injection and missing authorization in OnePlus OxygenOS allow locally installed apps to execute arbitrary commands without user interaction or declared permissions.
items.reason_zh: OnePlus OxygenOS 存在操作系统命令注入与权限校验缺失漏洞，允许已安装应用在无需用户交互或声明权限的情况下执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android enables unauthorized code execution by manipulating restricted directory access controls.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 存在路径遍历漏洞，攻击者可通过操纵受限目录访问控制实现未授权代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated HTTP server exposed by the Gallery app leaks external storage files over the local network, creating immediate privacy risks for mobile users.
items.reason_zh: Gallery app 暴露了未认证的 HTTP 服务，导致外部存储文件在局域网内泄露，给移动用户带来直接的隐私风险。

items.reason_en: Ensures safe reference handling for Bluetooth L2CAP channels, mitigating use-after-free vulnerabilities in mobile wireless stacks.
items.reason_zh: 修复蓝牙 L2CAP 通道引用处理逻辑，缓解移动无线协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Corrects a stride mismatch in ath11k MAC/PHY capability parsing, preventing memory corruption on mobile and network adapters.
items.reason_zh: 修正 ath11k MAC/PHY 能力解析中的步长不匹配问题，防止移动设备与网络适配器发生内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Bluetooth L2CAP stack enables remote code execution via crafted BLE packets targeting mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: 蓝牙 L2CAP 协议栈存在释放后使用漏洞，攻击者可通过构造 BLE 数据包对移动设备实施远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing synchronization in Wi-Fi 6E/7 monitor mode allows race conditions that corrupt packet processing on mobile chipsets.
items.reason_zh: Wi-Fi 6E/7 监控模式缺乏同步机制会引发竞态条件，导致移动芯片组的数据包处理过程出错。

items.reason_en: Division by zero in Bluetooth MTU handling causes local denial of service and potential stack corruption in mobile stacks.
items.reason_zh: 蓝牙 MTU 处理逻辑存在除零错误，可导致本地拒绝服务并引发移动协议栈潜在的栈溢出损坏。

items.reason_en: Unbounded reads on older USB TypeC controllers can overflow buffers, enabling local privilege escalation on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: 对旧款 USB TypeC 控制器的无界读取可能引发缓冲区溢出，进而导致移动设备本地提权。

items.reason_en: Samsung Bixby fails to properly validate input, allowing privileged local attackers to launch arbitrary activities and potentially escalate privileges on Android devices.
items.reason_zh: Samsung Bixby 存在输入验证缺陷，允许特权本地攻击者启动任意 Activity，并可能在 Android 设备上实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in the ThingLinks IoT platform allows attackers to exfiltrate or manipulate enterprise device data.
items.reason_zh: ThingLinks IoT 平台存在未授权 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者可借此窃取或篡改企业设备数据。

items.reason_en: Unbounded MQTT topic depth causes broker crashes, disrupting critical IoT communications.
items.reason_zh: MQTT 主题深度未受限制会导致消息代理崩溃，中断关键物联网通信。

items.reason_en: Symlink following in Pi-hole's update cron job allows overwriting critical system configuration files.
items.reason_zh: Pi-hole 更新定时任务存在符号链接跟随漏洞，可导致关键系统配置文件被覆盖。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 heap use-after-free in ESPAsyncWebServer affects popular ESP32/ESP8266 microcontroller web servers, enabling remote exploitation of edge devices.
items.reason_zh: ESPAsyncWebServer 存在 CVSS 评分 7.5 的堆区释放后使用漏洞，广泛影响基于 ESP32/ESP8266 的微控制器 Web 服务器，致使边缘设备面临远程利用风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.9 unsandboxed Groovy script execution in ThingLinks IoT platform allows authenticated attackers to achieve full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: ThingLinks IoT 平台存在 CVSS 评分 9.9 的未沙箱化 Groovy 脚本执行漏洞，经身份验证的攻击者可借此实现系统完全接管。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 missing authorization in ZTNET ZeroTier UI permits low-privilege users to permanently disable administrator accounts, undermining network segmentation controls.
items.reason_zh: ZTNET ZeroTier UI 存在 CVSS 评分 8.1 的权限校验缺失漏洞，低权限用户可借此永久禁用管理员账户，破坏网络隔离策略。

items.reason_en: Missing queue-set type validation in FreeRTOS allows unprivileged tasks to corrupt privileged kernel stack memory, breaking RTOS isolation guarantees in embedded devices.
items.reason_zh: FreeRTOS 存在队列集类型验证缺失漏洞，非特权任务可借此破坏特权内核栈内存，导致嵌入式设备的 RTOS 隔离机制失效。

items.reason_en: Lacks proper certificate validation in Eufy smart cameras, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks that can intercept traffic and lead to arbitrary code execution on the device.
items.reason_zh: Eufy 智能摄像头缺乏有效的证书验证机制，易受中间人攻击拦截流量，进而可能导致设备端任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Direct Lua function invocation in Teltonika RUTOS firmware bypasses API validations, allowing unauthenticated attackers to fully compromise network edge devices.
items.reason_zh: Teltonika RUTOS 固件支持直接调用 Lua 函数，绕过了 API 安全校验，使未授权攻击者可完全接管网络边缘设备。

items.reason_en: Command injection during the Eufy device pairing process enables unauthenticated attackers to execute system commands, potentially taking over smart home ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Eufy 设备配对流程存在命令注入漏洞，未授权攻击者可借此执行系统命令，进而威胁智能家居生态系统的控制权。

items.reason_en: Misuse of Bluetooth communication in SwitchBot Door Locks allows attackers to manipulate the protocol and physically bypass electronic locking mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: SwitchBot Door Locks 的蓝牙通信协议存在设计缺陷，攻击者可操纵通信协议以物理方式绕过电子锁止机制。

items.reason_en: Dahua's Intelligent Connection Center suffers from an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw, directly threatening surveillance and smart building infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Dahua 智能连接中心存在未授权远程代码执行漏洞，直接威胁安防监控与智慧建筑基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Crypttech Vatos DLP stores passwords in plaintext, enabling attackers who obtain encoded credentials to easily decode them and impersonate domain users.
items.reason_zh: Crypttech Vatos DLP 采用明文存储密码，攻击者获取编码凭据后可轻易解密并冒充域用户。

items.reason_en: Resolves an out-of-bounds read in the rtl8723bs Wi-Fi driver during WMM IE scanning, addressing a frequent attack vector in budget IoT hardware.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 rtl8723bs Wi-Fi 驱动在 WMM IE 扫描时的越界读取漏洞，消除了低成本物联网硬件中常见的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Properly cleans up the HID device list on probe failure, preventing resource leaks and instability in connected smart peripherals.
items.reason_zh: 在设备探测失败时正确清理 HID 设备列表，防止资源泄漏并确保连接智能外设的运行稳定性。

items.reason_en: Draining polled-VBUS timers before UDC teardown prevents use-after-free vulnerabilities in USB gadget emulation.
items.reason_zh: 在 UDC 销毁前清空轮询 VBUS 定时器，防止 USB Gadget 模拟过程中出现释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Registering regulators before exposing sysfs prevents race conditions that expose uninitialized hardware states to userspace.
items.reason_zh: 在暴露 sysfs 节点前完成电源调节器注册，避免竞态条件导致未初始化硬件状态泄露至用户空间。

items.reason_en: Preventing watchdog timer rearm during teardown ensures safety mechanisms remain active and prevent system hangs.
items.reason_zh: 在系统销毁阶段禁止重启看门狗定时器，可确保安全机制持续生效，防止系统死机。

items.reason_en: Fixing incorrect regmap locking in PCA953x IRQ sync prevents register corruption on I2C GPIO expanders.
items.reason_zh: 修复 PCA953x IRQ 同步中错误的 regmap 锁定可防止 I2C GPIO 扩展器上的寄存器损坏。

items.reason_en: Clearing RX buffers after I2C/SMBus transfers prevents sensitive data leakage between HID device transactions.
items.reason_zh: 在 I2C/SMBus 传输后清除 RX 缓冲区可防止 HID 设备事务间的敏感数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Concurrency flaws in IBM Z ISM hardware module allow request sequence violations, compromising secure element integrity in edge nodes.
items.reason_zh: IBM Z ISM 硬件模块中的并发缺陷可导致请求序列违规，破坏边缘节点中安全元件的完整性。

items.reason_en: Empty RX FIFO handling in SPI controllers leads to data corruption in embedded IoT peripheral communications.
items.reason_zh: SPI 控制器中空 RX FIFO 的处理不当会导致嵌入式 IoT 外设通信中的数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Improper bad inode handling in NTFS3 filesystems risks data corruption in IoT storage devices relying on Windows-compatible formats.
items.reason_zh: NTFS3 文件系统中对错误 inode 的处理不当可能导致依赖 Windows 兼容格式的 IoT 存储设备发生数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free during bridge multicast configuration exposes containerized IoT gateways to network traffic interception.
items.reason_zh: 桥接组播配置期间的释放后使用（Use-after-free）漏洞会使容器化 IoT 网关面临网络流量被拦截的风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication spoofing in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthorized actors to elevate privileges across cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric 中的身份验证伪造漏洞允许未授权攻击者在云工作负载中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Key-controlled authorization bypass in Azure AD B2C compromises foundational identity management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure AD B2C 中的密钥控制型授权绕过漏洞破坏了基础身份管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on Azure AI Language functions enables unrestricted access and potential service abuse.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Language 函数缺少身份验证机制，导致无限制访问及潜在的服务滥用风险。

items.reason_en: Insufficient data authenticity verification in Azure Billing permits financial fraud and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Billing 中数据真实性验证不足，可能导致财务欺诈与权限提升。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated admin account creation in the TAKO AI Agent bypasses initial tenant security controls.
items.reason_zh: TAKO AI Agent 中无需身份验证即可创建管理员账户，绕过了初始租户安全控制措施。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure CLI allows remote code execution during automated cloud management workflows.
items.reason_zh: Azure CLI 中的命令注入漏洞可在自动化云管理工作流期间导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Spring Cloud Azure enables network privilege escalation, directly undermining security controls in cloud-native microservice deployments.
items.reason_zh: Spring Cloud Azure 中的身份验证处理不当可导致网络权限提升，直接削弱云原生微服务部署中的安全控制措施。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 allows network remote code execution, posing severe risks to enterprise SaaS platforms and business workflows.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中对不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，对企业 SaaS 平台及业务工作流构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot Business Chat allows unauthorized information disclosure over the network, impacting cloud productivity suites.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot Business Chat 中的命令注入漏洞可导致未经授权的网络信息泄露，影响云生产力套件。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Microsoft Authenticator enables local privilege escalation, potentially compromising multi-factor authentication workflows.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Authenticator 中的身份验证处理不当可导致本地权限提升，可能破坏多因素身份验证工作流。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure HDInsights allows network-based privilege escalation, exposing managed big data cluster environments to exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsights 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞可导致基于网络的权限提升，使托管的大数据集群环境面临被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Dynamics 365 allows authorized attackers to execute arbitrary code, threatening enterprise cloud application integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中的代码注入漏洞允许已授权攻击者执行任意代码，威胁企业云应用程序的完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Hyper-V enables local code execution by authorized users, potentially leading to hypervisor escape or host compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许授权用户进行本地代码执行，可能导致 Hypervisor 逃逸或主机沦陷。

items.reason_en: Insufficiently protected credentials in Azure CycleCloud allow information disclosure, risking unauthorized access to cloud cluster management data.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中凭据保护不足可导致信息泄露，危及云集群管理数据的未授权访问风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10 missing authentication in Azure AI Foundry allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges and potentially compromise AI workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Foundry 中 CVSS 评分为 10 的身份验证缺失漏洞允许未授权攻击者提升权限，并可能破坏 AI 工作负载。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.9 command injection in M365 Copilot enables network-based privilege escalation within enterprise productivity environments.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 中 CVSS 评分为 9.9 的命令注入漏洞可在企业生产力环境中实现基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10 authorization bypass in Microsoft Container Registry allows unauthorized manipulation of container images, risking supply chain compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Container Registry 中 CVSS 评分为 10 的授权绕过漏洞允许未授权篡改容器镜像，存在供应链遭破坏的风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.1 authentication bypass in Microsoft Entra ID via alternate channels threatens global identity federation and access control mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中通过备用通道实现的 CVSS 评分为 9.1 的身份验证绕过漏洞威胁全球身份联合认证与访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: Inadequate conversation state isolation in Amazon Strands Agents SDK enables tenant data leakage and persistent instruction injection between isolated users.
items.reason_zh: Amazon Strands Agents SDK 中对话状态隔离不足可导致租户数据泄露，并在隔离用户之间引发持久化指令注入。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured Nginx routing in Cloud Foundry omits deny rules for internal v3 endpoints, exposing staging callbacks to unauthenticated exploitation and platform compromise.
items.reason_zh: Cloud Foundry 中错误配置的 Nginx 路由省略了内部 v3 端点的拒绝规则，导致暂存回调接口暴露于未授权利用及平台沦陷风险中。

items.reason_en: With a perfect CVSS 10.0 score, improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center enables immediate remote privilege escalation, directly compromising cloud identity and access management workflows.
items.reason_zh: 凭借完美的 CVSS 10.0 评分，Microsoft Partner Center 中证书验证处理不当可导致即时远程权限提升，直接破坏云身份与访问管理工作流。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure App Service allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, posing a critical risk to hosted web applications and microservices.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service 中缺失身份验证机制允许未授权攻击者远程执行任意代码，对托管的 Web 应用和微服务构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Microsoft Bookings facilitates unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, threatening enterprise scheduling and resource management platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Bookings 中的授权绕过漏洞便于通过网络进行未授权权限提升，威胁企业排程与资源管理平台。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 injection flaw in Azure Storage Library enables network-based privilege escalation, exposing cloud storage environments to unauthorized control.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Library 中 CVSS 评分为 8.1 的注入漏洞可导致基于网络的权限提升，使云存储环境面临未授权控制风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.1 cryptographic signature verification failure in AD FS allows authentication spoofing, undermining identity federation and single sign-on architectures.
items.reason_zh: AD FS 中的加密签名验证失败（CVSS 9.1）可导致身份伪造，破坏身份联合与单点登录架构。

items.reason_en: Improper communication channel restriction in Azure Key Vault allows privilege escalation over the network, risking cryptographic key management and cloud workload isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault 中通信通道限制不当可导致网络权限提升，危及加密密钥管理与云工作负载隔离。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager enables network-based privilege escalation, compromising centralized IT management and software deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager 中的SQL注入可实现基于网络的权限提升，破坏集中式IT管理与软件部署流水线。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Azure Attestation and Device Health Attestation Service exposes sensitive identity and health metadata, undermining zero-trust verification pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Azure Attestation 与 Device Health Attestation Service 中的越界读取会暴露敏感的身份与健康元数据，破坏零信任验证流水线。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in Windows Setup Files Cleanup allows local privilege escalation during system updates, potentially compromising newly provisioned cloud instances.
items.reason_zh: Windows Setup Files Cleanup 中的不受信任搜索路径可在系统更新期间导致本地权限提升，可能危及新配置的云实例。

items.reason_en: External control of file name or path in Windows Update enables local privilege escalation by manipulating update installation routines.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update 中的文件名或路径外部控制可通过操纵更新安装例程实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows Failover Cluster compromises highly available infrastructure and hypervisor management layers.
items.reason_zh: Windows Failover Cluster 中的远程代码执行会破坏高可用基础设施与 Hypervisor 管理层。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Hyper-V allows local privilege escalation within virtualized environments, increasing the risk of VM escape scenarios.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 中的释放后使用漏洞允许在虚拟化环境中实现本地权限提升，增加虚拟机逃逸风险。

items.reason_en: Denial of service in Host Guardian Service disrupts protection mechanisms for shielded virtual machines, impacting cloud workload integrity.
items.reason_zh: Host Guardian Service 中的拒绝服务漏洞会破坏屏蔽虚拟机的保护机制，影响云工作负载完整性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in SharePoint allows unauthorized network RCE. Directly compromises cloud-hosted collaboration platforms and risks data integrity across tenant environments.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致未授权的网络远程代码执行，直接破坏云托管协作平台，并危及跨租户环境的数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Power Apps enables unauthorized network RCE. Threatens low-code application ecosystems by bypassing frontend security controls.
items.reason_zh: Power Apps 中的源验证错误可导致未授权的网络远程代码执行，通过绕过前端安全控制威胁低代码应用生态。

items.reason_en: Information exposure in Azure HDInsight allows unauthorized network data disclosure. Risks sensitive analytics pipeline data and violates cloud compliance standards.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsight 中的信息泄露可导致未授权的网络数据披露，危及敏感分析流水线数据并违反云合规标准。

items.reason_en: Excessive memory allocation in Active Directory Federation Services enables unauthenticated denial of service over the network, disrupting cloud identity and single sign-on operations.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的内存分配过量可导致网络未授权拒绝服务，破坏云身份与单点登录操作。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service allows network privilege escalation. This vulnerability directly compromises container orchestration security and cluster integrity.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service 中缺失身份验证可导致网络权限提升，该漏洞直接破坏容器编排安全与集群完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in AAD App Proxy enables network privilege escalation. It weakens identity gateway protections, potentially allowing attackers to bypass cloud application access controls.
items.reason_zh: AAD App Proxy 中的身份验证不当可导致网络权限提升，削弱身份网关保护，可能使攻击者绕过云应用访问控制。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure Pipelines permits network remote code execution. This poses a severe risk to CI/CD workflows, enabling attackers to compromise build agents and inject malicious artifacts.
items.reason_zh: Azure Pipelines 中的命令注入允许网络远程代码执行，对 CI/CD 工作流构成严重风险，使攻击者能够入侵构建代理并注入恶意制品。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited buffer overflow in Google's Brotli decoder allows adjacent memory corruption and potential remote code execution across all supported platforms.
items.reason_zh: Google's Brotli decoder 中存在被主动利用的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致相邻内存损坏及潜在远程代码执行，影响所有支持平台。

items.reason_en: Critical SSRF in SAP Cloud SDK enables tenant subdomain manipulation to redirect OAuth2 token requests, facilitating mass credential exfiltration from multi-tenant BTP applications.
items.reason_zh: SAP Cloud SDK 中的关键SSRF漏洞可操纵租户子域名以重定向 OAuth2 令牌请求，从而从多租户 BTP 应用中大规模窃取凭证。

items.reason_en: Flawed FreeIPA self-managed OTP token access control permits unauthenticated LDAP clients to add attributes and compromise directory integrity without proper authentication checks.
items.reason_zh: FreeIPA 自管 OTP 令牌访问控制存在缺陷，允许未认证的 LDAP 客户端在缺乏适当身份验证检查的情况下添加属性，破坏目录完整性。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in Azure Arc enables unauthorized network-based privilege escalation, potentially compromising entire hybrid cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中的关键授权缺陷可导致未授权的基于网络权限提升，可能危及整个混合云环境。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure SQL Database allows attackers to pivot internally and escalate privileges, risking full database compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的服务端请求伪造漏洞可使攻击者进行内部横向移动并提升权限，危及数据库全面受损。

items.reason_en: Flawed name resolution in Azure Arc can be exploited remotely to escalate privileges, disrupting identity and access management workflows.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中的名称解析缺陷可被远程利用以提升权限，破坏身份与访问管理工作流。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Fabric allows authenticated attackers to escape restricted directories and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric 中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证的攻击者突破受限目录并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Authorization weaknesses in AKS permit attackers to escalate privileges and gain unauthorized control over container orchestration workloads.
items.reason_zh: AKS 中的授权弱点允许攻击者提升权限并对容器编排工作负载获得未授权控制。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaws in Dynamics 365 on-premises allow remote code execution, threatening critical customer relationship management systems.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 on-premises 中的反序列化缺陷可导致远程代码执行，威胁关键客户关系管理系统。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Power BI enables remote code execution, risking data integrity and computational resources in cloud analytics pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Power BI 中的输入验证不当可导致远程代码执行，危及云分析流水线中的数据完整性与计算资源。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud allows elevated privilege escalation over the network, exposing container orchestration workloads to unauthorized control.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失授权可导致网络提权，使容器编排工作负载暴露于未授权控制之下。

items.reason_en: Exploits symlink following during Nomad allocation migrations, potentially allowing malicious workloads to modify host directories and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: 利用 Nomad 分配迁移期间的符号链接跟随漏洞，可能允许恶意工作负载修改主机目录并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, impacting cloud-hosted collaboration services.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中不受信任数据的反序列化允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，影响云托管协作服务。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID permits remote code execution, threatening core cloud identity and authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，威胁核心云身份与认证基础设施。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Online allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges and manipulate internal cloud services.

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in DNS Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly undermining critical name resolution services and network stability.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的整数下溢漏洞可导致未经认证的网络安全远程代码执行，直接破坏关键名称解析服务和网络稳定性。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Network Load Balancing allows unauthenticated adjacent network attackers to execute code, compromising load balancing appliances and cluster integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Network Load Balancing中的释放后使用漏洞允许未认证的相邻网络攻击者执行代码，破坏负载均衡设备及集群完整性。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in DNS Server allows remote code execution. As a foundational network service, compromise disrupts name resolution and enables full network takeover.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的类型混淆漏洞可导致远程代码执行。作为基础网络服务，其被攻破将中断名称解析并导致整个网络被接管。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows iSCSI enables remote code execution. It exposes storage area networks to unauthorized control and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行。它使存储区域网络面临未经授权的控制和数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows iSCSI allows remote code execution. The memory corruption nature increases exploit reliability for attackers.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI中的越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行。其内存损坏特性提高了攻击者利用漏洞的成功率。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows DHCP Server permits remote code execution. Vulnerabilities in address assignment services can destabilize entire subnets.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server中的竞争条件漏洞可导致远程代码执行。地址分配服务中的漏洞可能导致整个子网不稳定。

items.reason_en: Command injection in HPE AOS-10 enables unauthenticated adjacent remote code execution. It compromises Aruba network infrastructure management interfaces, granting full control to nearby attackers.
items.reason_zh: HPE AOS-10中的命令注入漏洞可导致未经认证的相邻远程代码执行。它破坏了Aruba网络基础设施管理接口，赋予附近攻击者完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the HPE AOS-8 PAPI service allows unauthenticated adjacent remote code execution. This exposes critical access point management protocols to immediate exploitation without authentication.
items.reason_zh: HPE AOS-8 PAPI服务中的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未经认证的相邻远程代码执行。这使得关键接入点管理协议在无认证的情况下立即面临被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: OpenWrt's odhcpd reuses DHCPv6 authentication keys across multiple leases, allowing adjacent-network attackers to spoof router advertisements and hijack client routing.
items.reason_zh: OpenWrt的odhcpd在多个租约间重用DHCPv6认证密钥，允许相邻网络攻击者伪造路由器通告并劫持客户端路由。

items.reason_en: Crafted syslog messages trigger a heap buffer overflow in rsyslog's replace function, risking service disruption and potential memory exploitation on logging infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 精心构造的syslog消息会在rsyslog的replace函数中触发堆缓冲区溢出，危及日志基础设施的服务可用性及潜在的内存利用风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows iSCSI target service enables remote code execution, destabilizing critical storage networking infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI target service中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏关键存储网络基础设施的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Flawed origin validation in Windows NAT allows adjacent network spoofing, facilitating man-in-the-middle attacks and traffic interception.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT中的源地址验证缺陷允许相邻网络欺骗，助长中间人攻击和流量拦截。

items.reason_en: Malicious DHCP options can exploit dracut during network boot, enabling remote attackers to inject commands into initialization environments.
items.reason_zh: 恶意的DHCP选项可在网络启动期间利用dracut，使远程攻击者能够将命令注入初始化环境。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the QUIC protocol implementation leaks sensitive network information, weakening secure transport layer defenses.
items.reason_zh: QUIC协议实现中的释放后使用漏洞会泄露敏感网络信息，削弱安全传输层防御。

items.reason_en: A NULL pointer dereference in sniproproxy allows unauthenticated attackers to remotely crash the daemon via oversized TLS SNI names, causing service disruption.
items.reason_zh: sniproproxy 中的空指针解引用漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者通过过大的 TLS SNI 名称远程导致守护进程崩溃，从而引发服务中断。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds write in Windows DNS permits unauthenticated attackers to execute code over an adjacent network, compromising critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的越界写入漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者在相邻网络上执行代码，危及关键名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Dell PowerProtect Data Domain allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrative access to critical backup infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain 的身份验证缺陷允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者获取关键备份基础设施的管理权限。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Dell PowerProtect enables unauthorized reading and modification of restricted configuration files across storage networks.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerProtect 中的路径遍历漏洞允许跨存储网络未授权地读取和修改受限配置文件。

items.reason_en: UNC path injection in Cerberus FTP Server facilitates authentication coercion, leaking sensitive server credentials through manipulated SMB shares.
items.reason_zh: Cerberus FTP Server 中的 UNC 路径注入可促成身份验证强制，通过被篡改的 SMB 共享泄露敏感服务器凭据。

items.reason_en: Dell OpenManage Enterprise contains multiple command injection vulnerabilities exploitable by low-privileged remote attackers to execute system commands.
items.reason_zh: Dell OpenManage Enterprise 包含多个命令注入漏洞，低权限远程攻击者可利用其执行系统命令。

items.reason_en: OPNsense firmware mirror URL parameters accept shell metacharacters, allowing authenticated users to escalate privileges and execute commands as root.
items.reason_zh: OPNsense 固件镜像 URL 参数接受 Shell 元字符，允许已认证用户提升权限并以 root 身份执行命令。

items.reason_en: vsftpd's SSL session ticket reuse enables unauthenticated attackers to hijack FTPS data connections by resuming their own TLS tickets.
items.reason_zh: vsftpd 的 SSL 会话票证重用漏洞使未经身份验证的攻击者能够通过恢复自身 TLS 票证来劫持 FTPS 数据连接。

items.reason_en: A race condition in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP socket option handling can cause use-after-free conditions, destabilizing network stacks and enabling DoS.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 IPv4 TCP 套接字选项处理中的竞态条件可能导致释放后使用漏洞，破坏网络栈稳定性并引发拒绝服务(DoS)。

items.reason_en: Restores mTLS enforcement in Traefik Kubernetes Ingress provider, preventing silent authentication bypasses that expose backend services.
items.reason_zh: 恢复 Traefik Kubernetes Ingress 提供程序中的 mTLS 强制实施，防止因静默身份验证绕过而暴露后端服务。

items.reason_en: Fixes a heap out-of-bounds write in ksmbd Kerberos authentication, blocking remote code execution on Samba-based network shares.
items.reason_zh: 修复 ksmbd Kerberos 身份验证中的堆越界写入漏洞，阻止针对基于 Samba 的网络共享的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Prevents TCP skb collapsing across encryption boundaries, safeguarding packet integrity and preventing bypasses in encrypted network stacks.
items.reason_zh: 防止 TCP skb 跨越加密边界进行折叠，保障数据包完整性并防止加密网络栈中的绕过行为。

items.reason_en: Tree connection use-after-free in ksmbd allows remote attackers to corrupt kernel memory via malicious SMB requests.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd 中的树连接释放后使用漏洞允许远程攻击者通过恶意 SMB 请求破坏内核内存。

items.reason_en: Enforcing minimum length for krb5 tokens prevents authentication bypass and buffer overflows in GSSAPI-based RPC services.
items.reason_zh: 对 krb5 令牌强制执行最小长度限制，防止基于 GSSAPI 的 RPC 服务中出现身份验证绕过和缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Rejecting inline replies that overflow pull-up buffers in RPC/RDMA stops remote memory corruption attacks.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝 RPC/RDMA 中会导致上拉缓冲区溢出的内联回复，从而阻止远程内存破坏攻击。

items.reason_en: Fixing state flag races in SMC connections prevents connection state confusion and potential denial-of-service.
items.reason_zh: 修复 SMC 连接中的状态标志竞态条件，防止连接状态混淆及潜在的拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Preventing num_encaps underflow on bridge VLAN untag avoids kernel panics in netfilter flowtable offloading.
items.reason_zh: 防止网桥 VLAN 去标签操作中的 num_encaps 下溢，避免 netfilter 流表卸载时发生内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Restoring msg_iter before TLS 1.3 optimistic retry ensures correct decryption state tracking and prevents data leakage.
items.reason_zh: 在 TLS 1.3 乐观重试前恢复 msg_iter，确保正确的解密状态跟踪并防止数据泄露。

items.reason_en: The VXLAN module fixes a null pointer dereference during GRO preparation, addressing a critical stability flaw that could trigger kernel panics under heavy overlay network traffic.
items.reason_zh: VXLAN 模块修复了 GRO 准备阶段的空指针解引用问题，解决了在高负载覆盖网络流量下可能触发内核崩溃的关键稳定性缺陷。

items.reason_en: SCTP adds mandatory INIT chunk verification after cookie unpacking, closing a handshake bypass that allows unauthorized connection establishment without proper cryptographic validation.
items.reason_zh: SCTP 在 Cookie 解包后增加强制的 INIT 分块验证，修复了无需正确密码学验证即可未经授权建立连接的握手绕过漏洞。

items.reason_en: XFRM corrects stale skb->prev pointers after async crypto operations steal GSO segments, preventing packet list corruption and routing loops in IPsec tunnel deployments.
items.reason_zh: XFRM 修正了异步加密操作占用 GSO 分段后的过期 skb->prev 指针，防止 IPsec 隧道部署中出现数据包列表损坏和路由环路。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation of embedded INIT chunks in SCTP allows remote attackers to trigger out-of-bounds reads/writes via crafted cookie exchange packets.
items.reason_zh: SCTP 对嵌入 INIT 分块的验证不足，允许远程攻击者通过精心构造的 Cookie 交换数据包触发越界读写。

items.reason_en: A signedness bug in ksmbd negotiation preparation enables buffer overflow attacks against exposed SMB servers, potentially leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd 协商准备阶段存在符号性漏洞，可导致针对暴露 SMB 服务器的缓冲区溢出攻击，进而可能引发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated length parameters in the DLM search tree permit out-of-bounds writes via network messages, creating a direct path for remote exploitation.
items.reason_zh: DLM 搜索树中未验证的长度参数允许通过网络消息进行越界写入，为远程利用提供了直接途径。

items.reason_en: Compound request handling in ksmbd leads to out-of-bounds writes when response buffers are exhausted, critically endangering enterprise file-sharing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd 在处理复合请求时，若响应缓冲区耗尽将导致越界写入，严重危及企业文件共享基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing synchronization in the ksmbd channel list causes use-after-free conditions during multi-channel sessions, making it exploitable over network connections.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd 通道列表中缺乏同步机制，在多通道会话期间会引发释放后使用漏洞，使其可通过网络连接被利用。

items.reason_en: A race condition in SMB client cached file handle closure allows use-after-free attacks against mounted network shares, compromising client integrity.
items.reason_zh: SMB 客户端缓存文件句柄关闭过程中的竞态条件可导致针对已挂载网络共享的释放后使用攻击，破坏客户端完整性。

items.reason_en: Lack of data offset and length verification in SMB client reception enables buffer overflows and potential remote code execution on connected clients.
items.reason_zh: SMB 客户端接收过程中缺乏数据偏移量与长度验证，可导致缓冲区溢出并在已连接客户端上潜在引发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A race condition during SMB client work destruction leads to use-after-free when post-send credits work is pending, destabilizing network client operations.
items.reason_zh: SMB 客户端工作项销毁过程中的竞态条件会在发送后信用额度工作项待处理时引发释放后使用，破坏网络客户端操作的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in SMC listener teardown enables remote kernel code execution on mainframe and enterprise network appliances.
items.reason_zh: SMC 监听器清理过程中的释放后使用漏洞可在大型机和企业网络设备上实现远程内核代码执行。

items.reason_en: List corruption in XDP redirect paths causes kernel panics in high-throughput network forwarding pipelines.
items.reason_zh: XDP重定向路径中的链表损坏会导致高吞吐量网络转发流水线中出现内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Multichannel decryption race condition in SMB client leads to use-after-free, compromising enterprise file transfer security.
items.reason_zh: SMB客户端中的多通道解密竞态条件会导致释放后使用漏洞，危及企业文件传输安全。

items.reason_en: Missing header length validation in NVMe/TCP allows memory corruption via malicious storage targets.
items.reason_zh: NVMe/TCP中缺少头部长度验证可通过恶意存储目标导致内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Signing key use-after-free in SMB client breaks authentication integrity, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: SMB客户端中的签名密钥释放后使用会破坏认证完整性，从而启用中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Malformed completion descriptors in ENA network driver trigger resets, degrading cloud network performance and availability.
items.reason_zh: ENA网卡驱动中格式错误的完成描述符会触发重置，降低云网络的性能和可用性。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited per CISA KEV, this flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to trigger an unexpected device reload on Cisco ASA/FTD firewalls, causing widespread network downtime.
items.reason_zh: 根据CISA KEV记录正被积极利用，此漏洞允许未认证的远程攻击者在Cisco ASA/FTD防火墙上触发设备意外重启，导致大范围网络中断。

items.reason_en: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain Management Center suffers from authentication bypass via spoofing, granting unauthorized administrative access to enterprise storage networks.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain Management Center存在通过欺骗实现的认证绕过漏洞，使攻击者能够获取企业存储网络的未授权管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: A signed integer underflow in the Linux kernel's CIFS parser can lead to buffer overflows, compromising SMB-based file sharing infrastructure across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核CIFS解析器中的有符号整数下溢可能导致缓冲区溢出，危及企业网络中基于SMB的文件共享基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on POST/PUT endpoints in Delta Electronics chargers allows attackers to remotely reboot devices and brute-force configurations.
items.reason_zh: 台达电子充电器的POST/PUT端点缺少身份验证，允许攻击者远程重启设备并暴力破解配置。

items.reason_en: Predictable default credentials derived from device serial numbers in Delta UFC500 chargers enable adjacent network attackers to take full control.
items.reason_zh: Delta UFC500充电器中由设备序列号派生的可预测默认凭据，使相邻网络攻击者能够实施完全控制。

items.reason_en: Cleartext retention of factory default passwords in Delta WebUI templates exposes all account types to immediate credential stuffing attacks.
items.reason_zh: Delta WebUI模板中明文保留出厂默认密码，使所有账户类型立即面临撞库攻击风险。

items.reason_en: ARKETEAM Protectel security modules suffer from SQL injection via low-privileged user inputs, risking unauthorized data extraction and control system manipulation.
items.reason_zh: ARKETEAM Protectel安全模块存在通过低权限用户输入触发的SQL注入漏洞，可能导致未授权的数据提取和控制系统篡改。

items.reason_en: A second SQL injection flaw in the same industrial security suite affects another parameter, further expanding the attack surface for database tampering.
items.reason_zh: 同一工业安全套件中的第二个SQL注入漏洞影响另一个参数，进一步扩大了数据库篡改的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Forcing ACS requests when tboot is enabled strengthens DMA isolation and protects secure boot environments from rogue devices.
items.reason_zh: 在启用tboot时强制发送ACS请求可加强DMA隔离，保护安全启动环境免受非法设备侵害。

items.reason_en: Properly initializing NVMe abort work structures prevents storage controller instability and data corruption during aborts.
items.reason_zh: 正确初始化NVMe中止工作结构可防止存储控制器不稳定，并避免中止过程中发生数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Implementing slave_destroy interface for HiSilicon SAS hardware resolves link reset crashes in industrial storage arrays.
items.reason_zh: 为HiSilicon SAS硬件实现slave_destroy接口可解决工业存储阵列中的链路重置崩溃问题。

items.reason_en: Correcting undersized format-check buffer calculations prevents heap corruption on mainframe DASD storage devices.
items.reason_zh: 修正过小的格式化检查缓冲区计算可防止大型机DASD存储设备上发生堆损坏。

items.reason_en: Unwinding probe state on IOMMU registration failure prevents dangling references that crash embedded ARM systems.
items.reason_zh: 在IOMMU注册失败时清理探测状态可防止悬空引用，避免嵌入式ARM系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: Unauthorized BAR size modification in PCI endpoints bypasses memory protection, risking firmware tampering in industrial controllers.
items.reason_zh: PCI端点中未授权的BAR大小修改会绕过内存保护，危及工业控制器的固件安全。

items.reason_en: IOMMU window overlap with MMIO ranges causes address translation failures in legacy industrial server architectures.
items.reason_zh: IOMMU窗口与MMIO范围重叠会在传统工业服务器架构中导致地址转换失败。

items.reason_en: Interrupt handler overload in RDMA hardware causes soft lockups, halting real-time industrial data acquisition.
items.reason_zh: RDMA硬件的中断处理程序过载会导致软锁死，中断实时工业数据采集。

items.reason_en: Unprotected extent cache access during garbage collection corrupts flash storage, threatening PLC and SCADA system reliability.
items.reason_zh: 垃圾回收期间未受保护的extent缓存访问会损坏闪存，威胁PLC和SCADA系统的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Critical unauthenticated RCE in GitLab allows complete server compromise under certain conditions.
items.reason_zh: GitLab中存在关键的未认证远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，在特定条件下可导致服务器被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Authenticated integer overflow in GitLab enables remote code execution on the application server.
items.reason_zh: GitLab中的已认证整数溢出漏洞可在应用服务器上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited unauthenticated RCE via crafted regular expressions fully compromises GitLab instances.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造正则表达式触发的正被积极利用的未认证RCE漏洞，可完全攻破GitLab实例。

items.reason_en: Author-level remote code execution in a WordPress plugin enables full site takeover.
items.reason_zh: WordPress插件中的作者级远程代码执行漏洞可实现对网站的完全接管。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in IXP Manager allows non-administrative users to gain full administrative control.
items.reason_zh: IXP Manager中的权限提升漏洞允许非管理员用户获取完全的管理控制权。

items.reason_en: PHP object injection in a WordPress plugin enables arbitrary code execution on affected sites.
items.reason_zh: WordPress插件中的PHP对象注入漏洞可在受影响站点上实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network remote code execution, exposing collaboration platforms to unauthorized script execution.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中缺少授权机制可导致网络远程代码执行，使协作平台面临未授权脚本执行风险。

items.reason_en: External control of file name or path in .NET allows network privilege escalation, impacting web application deployment pipelines and runtime security.
items.reason_zh: .NET中文件名或路径的外部控制可导致网络权限提升，影响Web应用部署流水线及运行时安全。

items.reason_en: Execution with unnecessary privileges in SharePoint allows network privilege escalation, violating least-privilege principles in web service architectures.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中以非必要权限执行操作可导致网络提权，违反Web服务架构中的最小权限原则。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows network spoofing. Affects enterprise web collaboration and content management platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致网络欺骗，影响企业Web协作与内容管理平台。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network spoofing. Reinforces persistent risks in Microsoft's web publishing stack.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞可引发网络欺骗，凸显Microsoft Web发布栈的持久性风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge enables remote code execution over the network, targeting a widely used modern browser.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过网络实现远程代码执行，直接针对广泛使用的现代浏览器。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized security feature bypasses, affecting developer workstations and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可导致未授权的安全机制绕过，影响开发者工作站及CI/CD流水线。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in VSCode facilitates security control evasion, complicating traffic inspection and application firewall rules.
items.reason_zh: VSCode中的HTTP请求/响应走私可规避安全控制，增加流量检测与应用防火墙规则的复杂性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables attacker spoofing and phishing campaigns against email clients over the network.

items.reason_zh: SysInternals 工具中的非信任指针解引用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，在管理员故障排除与系统诊断过程中带来安全风险。

items.reason_en: ToCTOU race condition in the Linux Kernel enables local privilege escalation, affecting containerized environments and cloud host security.
items.reason_zh: Linux Kernel 中的 ToCTOU 竞争条件漏洞可导致本地权限提升，影响容器化环境及云主机安全。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Hyper-V allows local code execution, posing a risk to hypervisor stability and guest VM isolation.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地代码执行，对虚拟机监控程序的稳定性及客户机 VM 隔离性构成威胁。

items.reason_en: Double free in the Microsoft Failover Cluster Virtual Driver enables remote code execution, threatening high-availability server infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Failover Cluster Virtual Driver 中的双重释放漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁高可用服务器基础设施。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Windows SmartScreen allows local privilege escalation, bypassing built-in application reputation defenses.
items.reason_zh: Windows SmartScreen 中的类型混淆漏洞可导致本地权限提升，从而绕过内置的应用程序信誉防护机制。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges across managed enterprise endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证的攻击者在受管的企业终端上提升权限。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in the .NET runtime enables local privilege escalation through crafted file path inputs.
items.reason_zh: .NET 运行时中的链接解析不当漏洞可通过构造的文件路径输入实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in .NET allows restricted directory bypass, potentially exposing sensitive application files locally.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的路径遍历漏洞可绕过受限目录限制，可能导致本地敏感应用文件泄露。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in OpenSSH for Windows enables unauthorized network RCE. Compromises cross-platform secure shell implementations and remote administration tools.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未授权的网络远程代码执行（RCE）。危及跨平台安全 Shell 实现及远程管理工具。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Message Queuing allows local privilege escalation. Affects enterprise messaging infrastructure and inter-process communication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Message Queuing 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升。影响企业消息传递基础设施及进程间通信机制。

items.reason_en: Use after free in OpenSSH for Windows allows authorized local attackers to escalate privileges, highlighting ongoing risks in cross-platform remote administration tools.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 中的释放后使用漏洞允许已认证的本地攻击者提升权限，凸显了跨平台远程管理工具的持续安全风险。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Hello enables authorized local privilege escalation, potentially undermining biometric authentication security models on endpoint devices.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hello 中的释放后使用漏洞允许已认证的本地攻击者提升权限，可能破坏终端设备上的生物识别身份验证安全模型。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in .NET causes denial of service over a network. This impacts application availability across diverse software ecosystems relying on the framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中低效的算法复杂度可导致网络拒绝服务（DoS）。影响依赖该框架的各类软件生态系统中应用程序的可用性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows IKE Protocol allows denial of service over a network. Weakening cryptographic tunnel establishment affects VPN reliability and secure communications.
items.reason_zh: Windows IKE Protocol 中的越界读取漏洞可导致网络拒绝服务。削弱加密隧道建立过程会影响 VPN 可靠性及安全通信。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Message Queuing allows unauthenticated network RCE. Targets legacy messaging infrastructure, risking unauthorized code execution across networked systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows Message Queuing 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致未认证的网络远程代码执行（RCE）。针对遗留消息传递基础设施，危及联网系统中的未授权代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Compromised intermediate certificates trusted by JetBrains Toolbox and IDEs could allow attackers to intercept or manipulate development workflows and source code delivery.
items.reason_zh: 被 JetBrains Toolbox 及 IDEs 信任的受损中间证书可能使攻击者能够拦截或篡改开发工作流及源代码分发过程。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Paperclip AI allows workspace owners to execute arbitrary cleanup commands, directly compromising the underlying infrastructure hosting AI agents.
items.reason_zh: Paperclip AI 中的远程代码执行漏洞允许工作区所有者执行任意清理命令，直接危及托管 AI 代理的底层基础设施。

items.reason_en: Invalid pointer dereference in the VTK image processing library triggers denial of service when parsing malicious PNG files, affecting scientific visualization tools.
items.reason_zh: VTK图像处理库中的无效指针解引用在解析恶意PNG文件时会触发拒绝服务漏洞，影响科学可视化工具。

items.reason_en: Symbolic link vulnerability in MRTG allows local privilege escalation when the daemon runs with elevated permissions, impacting network monitoring setups.
items.reason_zh: MRTG中的符号链接漏洞允许本地权限提升，当守护进程以高权限运行时会影响网络监控部署。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution over a network, compromising developer workstations and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，危及开发人员工作站和CI/CD流水线。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in VS Code enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, posing significant risks to software development environments.
items.reason_zh: VS Code中的代码注入漏洞使远程攻击者能够执行任意代码，对软件开发环境构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in the VTK library's DEMReader can be triggered by malicious geospatial files, affecting scientific computing and visualization applications.
items.reason_zh: VTK库的DEMReader模块中的内存破坏可由恶意地理空间文件触发，影响科学计算与可视化应用。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in the VTK WindBladeReader module allows local code execution when processing specially crafted .wind files, affecting scientific visualization workflows.
items.reason_zh: VTK WindBladeReader模块中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出在处理特制的.wind文件时允许本地代码执行，影响科学可视化工作流。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Kubeflow Pipelines log retrieval allows unauthorized callers to access sensitive ML workflow logs and metadata.
items.reason_zh: Kubeflow Pipelines日志检索中缺少授权机制，允许未授权调用者访问敏感的机器学习工作流日志和元数据。

items.reason_en: Unlimited recipients array processing in joserfc JWE decryption causes denial of service when unauthenticated actors send crafted cryptographic payloads.
items.reason_zh: joserfc JWE解密中未限制接收者数组处理，当未认证实体发送精心构造的加密载荷时会引发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: NUL character handling flaw in gnutls RSA-PSK configuration enables remote authentication bypass by truncating usernames.
items.reason_zh: gnutls RSA-PSK配置中的NUL字符处理缺陷可通过截断用户名实现远程身份验证绕过。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Progress Software WS_FTP Server permits arbitrary command execution under certain configurations, compromising file transfer operations.
items.reason_zh: Progress Software WS_FTP Server中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，在特定配置下允许执行任意命令，危及文件传输操作。

items.reason_en: Omitted authentication hooks in Bazarr Plex API handlers allow anonymous attackers to invoke restricted resource handlers without API keys.
items.reason_zh: Bazarr Plex API处理器中缺失的身份验证钩子允许匿名攻击者在无API密钥的情况下调用受限资源处理器。

items.reason_en: InternLM LMDeploy exposes an unauthenticated RCE via pickle deserialization on its weights update endpoint, allowing immediate OS command execution.
items.reason_zh: InternLM LMDeploy在其权重更新端点通过pickle反序列化暴露了未认证的RCE漏洞，允许立即执行操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: MindsDB's OpenBBtable class allows authenticated attackers to inject and execute arbitrary code through malicious table configuration payloads.
items.reason_zh: MindsDB的OpenBBtable类允许已认证攻击者通过恶意的表配置载荷注入并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: MONAI Auto3DSeg triggers remote code execution by importing malicious algorithm templates from a crafted JSON configuration file.
items.reason_zh: MONAI Auto3DSeg通过从精心构造的JSON配置文件中导入恶意算法模板触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Jupyter nbconvert joins attacker-controlled filenames to output directories without sanitization, enabling path traversal and arbitrary file writes.
items.reason_zh: Jupyter nbconvert在未进行过滤的情况下将攻击者控制的文件名拼接到输出目录，导致路径遍历和任意文件写入。

items.reason_en: pybars3 template compiler fails to properly escape bracketed path segments, allowing Python code execution within Handlebars templates.
items.reason_zh: pybars3模板编译器未能正确转义带方括号的路径段，导致可在Handlebars模板中执行Python代码。

items.reason_en: Eliminates a use-after-free in Open vSwitch connection tracking caused by extension reallocation, stabilizing core software-defined networking components.
items.reason_zh: 修复了由扩展重新分配引起的Open vSwitch连接跟踪中的释放后使用漏洞，稳定了核心软件定义网络组件。

items.reason_en: Prevents slab-out-of-bounds writes in the NTFS3 driver during attribute list creation, mitigating privilege escalation risks from malicious disk images.
items.reason_zh: 防止NTFS3驱动程序在创建属性列表时发生slab越界写入，降低恶意磁盘镜像导致的权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: Stops NFSD from retaining raw pointers to closed clients on LRU lists, preventing use-after-free crashes during server-side cleanup operations.
items.reason_zh: 阻止NFSD在LRU列表中保留指向已关闭客户端的原始指针，防止服务器端清理操作期间发生释放后使用崩溃。

items.reason_en: Validating MOVE_RANGE destination sizes prevents source hole exposure and filesystem metadata corruption in F2FS.
items.reason_zh: 验证MOVE_RANGE目标大小可防止F2FS文件系统出现源空洞暴露和元数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Rejecting inline extents without valid LZO headers stops crafted image exploitation causing slab-out-of-bounds crashes.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝不含有效LZO头部的内联扩展，可阻止因精心构造的镜像利用而引发的slab越界崩溃。

items.reason_en: Fixing infinite loops in fwnode child iteration prevents system hangs caused by malformed device tree configurations.
items.reason_zh: 修复fwnode子节点迭代中的无限循环，可防止因设备树配置错误导致的系统挂起。

items.reason_en: Avoiding double-free of registered video_device callbacks eliminates classic use-after-free bugs in legacy media drivers.
items.reason_zh: 避免对已注册的video_device回调进行双重释放，消除了传统媒体驱动中的经典释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Fixing lost inode updates for IS_SYNC inodes ensures strict data consistency guarantees in ext2 filesystems.
items.reason_zh: 修复IS_SYNC类型inode更新丢失问题，确保ext2文件系统的严格数据一致性保障。

items.reason_en: Security keys fixes a missing RCU read-side critical section during keyring lookups, preventing use-after-free vulnerabilities in kernel credential and certificate management.
items.reason_zh: Security keys修复了密钥环查找期间缺失的RCU读侧临界区，防止内核凭据和证书管理中的释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: ALSA OSS sequencer resolves a use-after-free when processing MIDI events with embedded SysEx data, mitigating audio subsystem exploitation risks in desktop and server environments.
items.reason_zh: ALSA OSS音序器解决了处理包含嵌入式SysEx数据的MIDI事件时的释放后使用漏洞，降低了桌面和服务器环境中音频子系统被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: SoundWire driver fixes an out-of-bounds memory access in element group counting, resolving a syzkaller-triggered crash caused by malformed hardware descriptor loops.
items.reason_zh: SoundWire驱动程序修复了元素组计数中的越界内存访问，解决了由畸形硬件描述符循环触发的syzkaller崩溃。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in VXLAN FDB refresh impacts SDN overlay network stability and routing consistency.
items.reason_zh: VXLAN FDB刷新过程中的空指针解引用影响了SDN覆盖网络的稳定性和路由一致性。

items.reason_en: Infinite tailcall loops in eBPF freplace mechanisms enable denial of service in observability and security tooling.
items.reason_zh: eBPF freplace机制中的无限尾调用循环可导致可观测性和安全工具面临拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Race conditions around huge page fault handling destabilize memory management frameworks used by various system utilities.
items.reason_zh: 大页缺页处理周围的竞态条件会破坏各类系统工具所使用的内存管理框架的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Reference count leak in ksmbd causes gradual memory exhaustion, impacting generic file sharing middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd中的引用计数泄漏会导致渐进式内存耗尽，影响通用文件共享中间件的部署。

items.reason_en: The Linux kernel's ESP networking implementation mishandles page_pool references, leading to memory corruption and potential denial of service in kernel-space network processing.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核的ESP网络实现对page_pool引用的处理不当，会导致内存损坏，并在内核空间网络处理过程中可能引发拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Netfilter's nf_tables subsystem triggers a use-after-free when tracing stolen SKBs, undermining kernel firewall integrity and stability.
items.reason_zh: Netfilter的nf_tables子系统在追踪被劫持的SKB时会触发释放后使用（Use-After-Free）漏洞，从而危及内核防火墙的完整性与稳定性。
